sloka: कृतं कर्म यशः श्लाध्यं प्राप्तं ते शत्रुसूदन ।भ्रातृभिः सह राज्यस्थो दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुहि ।इति ब्रुवाणं राजानं रामः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत् ।। ६.१२२.२४ ।।
transliteration: kṛtaṁ karma yaśaḥ ślādhyaṁ prāptaṁ te śatrusūdana ।bhrātṛbhiḥ saha rājyastho dīrghamāyuravāpnuhi ।iti bruvāṇaṁ rājānaṁ rāmaḥ prāñjalirabravīt ।। 6.122.24 ।।

translations.english: O slayer of foes, you have accomplished a praiseworthy deed and won fame; now, established in your kingdom with your brothers, enjoy a long life.
